// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
//  app/_menu-overlay.scss — the fullscreen menu overlay: WebGL contour
//  canvas, the SVG-turbulence CSS membrane fallback, staggered menu
//  items + entrance/exit keyframes, the playground-pinned dark variant,
//  modal header/close button, and the modal nav title/close triggers.
//  Imported by app.scss (manifest) — uses $_B_NAV defined there.
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

// ── Fullscreen mobile menu modal ──────────────────────────────────────────
// The modal subtree is re-created on every render, so entrance motion must
// use @keyframes (they play on insertion); exit uses the --closing modifier
// with transitions applied to the live element.
.#{$_B_NAV}-menu-modal {
  display: none;
  position: fixed;
  inset: 0;
  z-index: 1000;
  background: var(--menu-bg, var(--bg-darkest, var(--bg-primary)));
  overflow: hidden;

  &--open {
    display: block;
    animation: #{$_B_NAV}-menu-in 1.4s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1) both;
  }

  &--settled {
    animation: none;
  }

  &--closing {
    animation: none;
    opacity: 0;
    transition: opacity 0.8s ease 0.1s;
    pointer-events: none;
  }
}

@keyframes #{$_B_NAV}-menu-in {
  from {
    opacity: 0;
  }

  to {
    opacity: 1;
  }
}

// The animated menu background canvas (contour/noise field).
.#{$_B_NAV}-menu-modal-canvas {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  pointer-events: none;

  &.is-fallback {
    display: none;
  }
}

// ── CSS fallback membrane: turbulence isolines mimicking the shader ────────
// The WebGL field draws thin contour lines; the fallback paints the same idea
// with two ink layers clipped by SVG feTurbulence + a sparse feFuncA table —
// narrow alpha spikes at a few noise thresholds = organic isolines, not bands.
$_TURB-A: 'data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg xmlns=%27http://www.w3.org/2000/svg%27 width=%27420%27 height=%27420%27%3E%3Cfilter id=%27f%27%3E%3CfeTurbulence type=%27fractalNoise%27 baseFrequency=%270.009 0.014%27 numOctaves=%273%27 seed=%277%27/%3E%3CfeComponentTransfer%3E%3CfeFuncA type=%27table%27 tableValues=%270 0 0 0.4 0 0.85 0 0 0.5 0 0.28 0 0 0.15 0%27/%3E%3C/feComponentTransfer%3E%3C/filter%3E%3Crect width=%27420%27 height=%27420%27 filter=%27url%28%23f%29%27/%3E%3C/svg%3E';
$_TURB-B: 'data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg xmlns=%27http://www.w3.org/2000/svg%27 width=%27420%27 height=%27420%27%3E%3Cfilter id=%27g%27%3E%3CfeTurbulence type=%27fractalNoise%27 baseFrequency=%270.006 0.011%27 numOctaves=%273%27 seed=%2719%27/%3E%3CfeComponentTransfer%3E%3CfeFuncA type=%27table%27 tableValues=%270 0 0.55 0 0 0.3 0 0 0.75 0 0 0.2 0%27/%3E%3C/feComponentTransfer%3E%3C/filter%3E%3Crect width=%27420%27 height=%27420%27 filter=%27url%28%23g%29%27/%3E%3C/svg%3E';

.#{$_B_NAV}-menu-modal-fallback {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  display: none;
  pointer-events: none;
  overflow: hidden;

  &::before,
  &::after {
    content: '';
    position: absolute;
    inset: -15%;
    background: currentColor;
  }

  &::before {
    color: var(--menu-ink, var(--text-primary));
    -webkit-mask-image: url('#{$_TURB-A}');
    mask-image: url('#{$_TURB-A}');
    -webkit-mask-size: 140% 140%;
    mask-size: 140% 140%;
    -webkit-mask-repeat: no-repeat;
    mask-repeat: no-repeat;
    animation: #{$_B_NAV}-membrane-drift 38s ease-in-out infinite alternate;
  }

  &::after {
    color: var(--menu-ink-2, var(--menu-ink, var(--text-primary)));
    opacity: 0.4;
    -webkit-mask-image: url('#{$_TURB-B}');
    mask-image: url('#{$_TURB-B}');
    -webkit-mask-size: 165% 165%;
    mask-size: 165% 165%;
    -webkit-mask-repeat: no-repeat;
    mask-repeat: no-repeat;
    animation: #{$_B_NAV}-membrane-drift-alt 52s ease-in-out infinite alternate;
  }

  animation: #{$_B_NAV}-membrane-in 2.6s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1) both;

  .#{$_B_NAV}-menu-modal--settled & {
    opacity: 0.1;
  }

  .#{$_B_NAV}-menu-modal--closing & {
    animation: none;
    opacity: 0;
    transition: opacity 0.4s ease;
  }
}

// Entrance mirrors the shader's reveal: pure opacity fade, no transform —
// the background field must stay stable while the modal animates around it.
@keyframes #{$_B_NAV}-membrane-in {
  from {
    opacity: 0;
  }

  to {
    opacity: 0.1;
  }
}

// The turbulence tile slides so the isoline field visibly breathes
@keyframes #{$_B_NAV}-membrane-drift {
  from {
    -webkit-mask-position: 0 0;
    mask-position: 0 0;
  }

  to {
    -webkit-mask-position: 14% 9%;
    mask-position: 14% 9%;
  }
}

@keyframes #{$_B_NAV}-membrane-drift-alt {
  from {
    -webkit-mask-position: 8% 12%;
    mask-position: 8% 12%;
  }

  to {
    -webkit-mask-position: -6% -4%;
    mask-position: -6% -4%;
  }
}

.#{$_B_NAV}-menu-modal:has(.#{$_B_NAV}-menu-modal-canvas.is-fallback)
  .#{$_B_NAV}-menu-modal-fallback,
.#{$_B_NAV}-menu-modal--gl-fallback .#{$_B_NAV}-menu-modal-fallback {
  display: block;
}

// Playground routes: the fullscreen scene behind the modal is always
// dark, so pin the menu surface + inks to the dark variant regardless of
// the global theme — links, the contour shader (which samples the
// canvas's computed --menu-ink*), and the CSS fallback all stay
// white-on-dark there.
// The logo link is pinned to pure white too — --on-dark's --grey-2 reads
// as a dim grey, and on the dark playground scene the logo must read as
// full-strength white from the very first paint.
.#{$_B_NAV}--playground {
  .#{$_B_NAV}-menu-modal {
    --menu-bg: var(--bg-darkest);
    --menu-ink: var(--color-white-raw);
    --menu-ink-2: var(--color-white-raw);
  }

  .#{$_B_NAV}-logo-btn {
    color: var(--color-white-raw);
  }
}

// Menu overlay top row: title + circular close button.
.#{$_B_NAV}-menu-modal-header {
  @extend %MAXAREA;

  position: absolute;
  top: var(--space-lg);
  left: 0;
  width: 100%;
  display: flex;
  justify-content: flex-end;
  align-items: center;
  z-index: 2;
  box-sizing: border-box;
  opacity: 0;

  .#{$_B_NAV}-menu-modal--open & {
    animation: #{$_B_NAV}-menu-fade-up 0.5s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1) 0.15s both;
  }

  .#{$_B_NAV}-menu-modal--settled & {
    animation: none;
    opacity: 1;
    transform: none;
  }

  .#{$_B_NAV}-menu-modal--closing & {
    animation: none;
    opacity: 0;
    transition: opacity 0.25s ease;
  }
}

@keyframes #{$_B_NAV}-menu-fade-up {
  from {
    opacity: 0;
    transform: translateY(calc(-1 * var(--space-xs)));
  }

  to {
    opacity: 1;
    transform: translateY(0);
  }
}

// Menu item column, centered.
.#{$_B_NAV}-menu-modal-content {
  position: relative;
  z-index: 1;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  height: 100%;
  gap: var(--space-xl);
  padding: var(--space-2xl);
  box-sizing: border-box;
}

// Each menu entry: large thin-weight label with hover/active states; staggers in via menu-item-in.
.#{$_B_NAV}-menu-modal-item {
  @extend %RESETBTN;

  position: relative;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: var(--space-md);
  padding: var(--space-md) var(--space-xl);
  width: var(--space-7xl);
  max-width: calc(100vw - var(--space-3xl));
  box-sizing: border-box;
  color: var(--menu-ink, var(--text-primary));
  font-family: var(--font-primary);
  font-size: var(--space-lg);
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: var(--space-2xs);
  text-transform: uppercase;
  white-space: nowrap;
  cursor: pointer;
  background: transparent;
  opacity: 1;
  transition:
    letter-spacing 0.6s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1),
    opacity 0.35s ease,
    filter 0.35s ease,
    transform 0.35s ease;

  // Hairline underline drawn on the item (the label letters' parent) — it
  // stays hidden while draw-text writes the label, then sweeps in once the
  // chars land (--draw-ms is set per item at render).
  &::after {
    content: '';
    position: absolute;
    left: 50%;
    bottom: 0;
    width: 100%;
    height: var(--space-hairline);
    background: var(--menu-ink, var(--text-primary));
    opacity: 0.25;
    transform: translateX(-50%) scaleX(0);
    transition:
      transform 0.7s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1),
      opacity 0.3s ease;
  }

  &:hover,
  &:focus-visible,
  &:focus-within {
    letter-spacing: var(--space-xs);

    &::after {
      opacity: 0.75;
    }
  }

  // Pressed / pressing: the label tightens and the line gains full ink.
  &:active {
    letter-spacing: var(--space-2xs);
    transform: translateY(var(--space-hairline));

    &::after {
      opacity: 0.95;
    }
  }

  .#{$_B_NAV}-menu-modal--open & {
    // Shell gets a quick settle-in fade; the label's letters provide the
    // real entrance via draw-text, so no blur/translate double-animation.
    animation: #{$_B_NAV}-menu-item-in 0.45s ease both;

    &::after {
      transform: translateX(-50%) scaleX(1);
      transition-delay: var(--draw-ms, 0.6s);
    }
  }

  .#{$_B_NAV}-menu-modal--settled & {
    animation: none;

    &::after {
      transition: none;
    }
  }

  .#{$_B_NAV}-menu-modal--closing & {
    animation: none;
    opacity: 0;
    filter: blur(var(--space-xs));
    transform: translateY(calc(-1 * var(--space-sm)));
    transition:
      letter-spacing 0.6s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1),
      opacity 0.55s ease,
      filter 0.55s ease,
      transform 0.55s ease;

    &::after {
      transform: translateX(-50%) scaleX(0);
      transition-delay: 0s;
    }
  }

  // Current section: hairline fully visible, no letter-spacing jump
  &--active::after {
    opacity: 0.75;
  }

  // Flag inside the language item: height-driven, natural aspect ratio
  .flag-canvas,
  .flag-img {
    height: var(--space-lg);
    width: auto;
    border-radius: var(--space-3xs);
  }

  .flag-split {
    display: inline-flex;
    overflow: hidden;
    border-radius: var(--space-3xs);
  }

  .#{$_B_NAV}-flag-wrapper:has(.flag-canvas:not(.is-fallback)) {
    .flag-img,
    .flag-split {
      display: none;
    }
  }

  // The flag lands WITH the label — it fades in on the item's draw-text
  // offset. This must be an ANIMATION, not a transition: the items are
  // inserted after --open is already on the modal, so a transition never
  // replays (element mounts at opacity 1 → flag beat the text every
  // open). Animations run on insertion, so the offset delay actually
  // takes.
  @keyframes nav-flag-in {
    to {
      opacity: 1;
    }
  }

  .#{$_B_NAV}-flag-wrapper {
    opacity: 0;

    .#{$_B_NAV}-menu-modal--open & {
      animation: nav-flag-in 0.4s ease var(--offset-ms, 0ms) forwards;
    }

    .#{$_B_NAV}-menu-modal--settled & {
      animation: none;
      opacity: 1;
    }

    .#{$_B_NAV}-menu-modal--closing & {
      animation: none;
      opacity: 0;
    }
  }
}

@keyframes #{$_B_NAV}-menu-item-in {
  from {
    opacity: 0;
  }

  to {
    opacity: 1;
  }
}

// WebGL close button — positioned inside modal header at exact same place & size as burger
.#{$_B_NAV}-menu-modal .pref-close-btn {
  @extend %RESETBTN;

  position: relative;
  flex-shrink: 0;
  width: var(--space-2xl);
  height: var(--space-2xl);
  border-radius: var(--radius-round);
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  cursor: pointer;
  color: var(--text-secondary);
  background: var(--border-color);
  overflow: hidden;
  z-index: 2;
  transition:
    background 0.2s ease,
    transform 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1);
}

.#{$_B_NAV}-menu-modal .pref-close-canvas {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  border-radius: var(--radius-round);
  display: block;
  pointer-events: none;

  &.is-fallback {
    display: none;
  }
}

// Fallback close button icon when WebGL fails
.#{$_B_NAV}-menu-modal:has(.pref-close-canvas.is-fallback) .pref-close-btn {
  position: relative;

  &::before,
  &::after {
    content: '';
    position: absolute;
    inset: 50% auto auto 50%;
    translate: -50% -50%;
    width: var(--space-md);
    height: var(--space-2xs);
    background: var(--text-primary);
    border-radius: var(--radius-2xs);
  }

  &::before {
    rotate: 45deg;
  }

  &::after {
    rotate: -45deg;
  }
}

// When modal is open, the nav shows these instead of page links.
.modal-nav-title {
  @extend %TTL_BASE;
  @extend %TTL_XS;

  font-weight: 200;
  color: var(--menu-ink, var(--text-primary));
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: to-rem(2);
  text-overflow: ellipsis;
  overflow: hidden;
  white-space: nowrap;
  max-width: 60%;
  opacity: 0.7;
}

// Close trigger inside the menu overlay.
.modal-nav-close {
  @extend %RESETBTN;
  @extend %TTL_BASE;
  @extend %TTL_XS;

  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--menu-ink, var(--text-primary));
  cursor: pointer;
  position: relative;
  padding: var(--space-xs) var(--space-md);
  transition: color 0.2s ease;

  &::before,
  &::after {
    content: '';
    position: absolute;
    width: var(--space-md);
    height: var(--space-md);
    transition:
      width 0.2s ease,
      height 0.2s ease;
  }

  &::before {
    top: 0;
    left: 0;
    border-top: 1px solid currentColor;
    border-left: 1px solid currentColor;
  }

  &::after {
    bottom: 0;
    right: 0;
    border-bottom: 1px solid currentColor;
    border-right: 1px solid currentColor;
  }

  &:hover,
  &:focus-visible {
    color: var(--white);

    &::before,
    &::after {
      width: calc(100% - var(--space-xs));
      height: calc(100% - var(--space-xs));
    }
  }
}
